summary: This theme groups clusters highlighting methodological constraints in GenAI and language education research, including reliance on self-reported data, quantitative biases, lack of longitudinal studies, and insufficient exploration of contextual or perceptual factors.

This theme addresses limitations in the broader applicability of GenAI and language education research, such as narrow sample sizes, cultural/linguistic specificity, and restricted datasets or genres, which hinder cross-population validity.
This theme focuses on the constraints of short-term or cross-sectional studies in assessing the long-term impacts, causality, or sustained effects of GenAI in language education.
This theme reflects the absence of actionable research statements in the provided cluster, preventing thematic analysis or synthesis of GenAI and language education trends.
